ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe exhibits a dominant high-intensity background with several isolated, roughly circular low-intensity (black) blobs. Right lobe contains a large, irregular, contiguous low-intensity mass covering the proximal and medial regions, transitioning to a high-intensity distal region containing small, scattered low-intensity circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations present across the entire trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with vertical pixel-amplitudes between 5 and 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow a predominantly convex curve from the proximal region toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, jagged, and textured pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonization are clearly visible at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the distal high-intensity surface of the right lobe, breaking the consistent pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of barnacles at both lobe tips; multiple distinct circular dark markings on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry, with the right lobe featuring a significantly larger contiguous dark region compared to the predominantly light-colored left lobe.
